shots.prompt: Close-up food commercial shot. The pizzaiolo's fingertips press and stretch the round pizza dough on the floured white marble counter, working around the edge to form a puffy raised rim, the dough becoming thinner and wider. Flour dust in the warm light, the fire of the wood-fired oven flickers in the background. Slow camera push-in. Realistic, natural hand motion, cinematic.

The steel ladle pours thick red tomato sauce onto the center of the bare pizza dough, then the back of the ladle spreads the sauce outward in a slow spiral, covering the dough and leaving the puffy rim clean. Close-up food commercial shot, realistic, smooth natural motion, warm light.
Hands tear pieces of fresh white mozzarella and place them one by one onto the red tomato sauce on the pizza dough. Close-up food commercial shot, realistic, natural hand motion, soft warm light.

The camera slowly pushes in toward the glowing mouth of the copper-domed wood-fired pizza oven. Flames flicker and dance inside the oven, warm firelight shimmers on the hammered copper dome. Cinematic, realistic, steady smooth camera.

Inside a wood-fired pizza oven, close-up: the pizza bakes, the crust puffs up and turns golden brown with dark charred leopard spots, the mozzarella melts, spreads and bubbles, flames roll across the dome, glowing embers. Realistic, cinematic food commercial.

Slow cinematic push-in on a freshly baked Neapolitan margherita pizza in a cardboard box, gentle steam rising from the hot melted mozzarella, the cheese glistens, fresh basil leaves, warm golden sunlight, shallow depth of field, photorealistic.
